question: I'm 19 with 48 UCAS points and GCSE English and Maths. Can I join the HND in Computing?
draft:
Dear Student,

Thank you for your interest in the HND in Computing at Northbridge College London. 

While you meet the age requirement and have GCSE English and Maths, the standard entry requirement for this course is 64 UCAS points (or a Level 3 Diploma in IT pass), and currently you have 48 UCAS points. 

Because this requires a staff decision regarding your application, a member of the admissions team will follow up with you soon.

Best regards,

Admissions Team, Northbridge College London

name: SAmra
question: please help me with refund
draft:
Dear Student,

Thank you for reaching out to us. 

To help you understand our refund process, here are the key facts regarding our refund policy:
• Within 14 days of accepting an offer: You will receive a full refund of any payments made.
• After 14 days but before the course starts: You will receive a refund minus a £250 administration fee.
• After the course starts: No refund is given, except in exceptional circumstances approved by the Head of Admissions.
• Visa refusals: International deposits are refunded in full upon providing proof of visa refusal.

Please note that all refund decisions are made by the Finance Office, not by admissions staff. A member of the admissions team will follow up with you regarding your request.

Best regards,

Admissions Team, Northbridge College London
reasons: Refund question: only the Finance Office can decide refunds
recommendation: Forward to the Finance Office and make sure the reply doesn't promise a refund.

name: Triage Test
question: I am 22, an international student from Pakistan with IELTS 5.5 and 70 UCAS points. Can I join the HND in Computing?
draft:
Dear Student,

Thank you for your interest in the HND in Computing at Northbridge College London. 

Based on your current profile, you have 70 UCAS points, which meets the academic requirement. However, international students applying for the HND in Computing need an IELTS score of 6.0 overall (with no band below 5.5), and your current IELTS score is 5.5. 

Because this requires a staff decision regarding your eligibility, a member of the admissions team will follow up with you soon. 

Best regards,

Admissions Team, Northbridge College London
reasons: Doesn't meet entry requirements for HND in Computing: needs IELTS 6.0 (has 5.5)
International applicant: check visa and IELTS details
recommendation: Confirm the shortfall, consider pointing them to a course they do qualify for, then approve.
summary:

* **Your Profile:** You are 22 years old, an international student from Pakistan, with 70 UCAS points and an IELTS score of 5.5.
* **Eligibility Verdict:** According to the entry requirements check, you currently **do not meet the requirements** because your IELTS score is 5.5, whereas 6.0 is required for international students on this course.
